idea: Week two, from the story bank: written from the tables, then corrected by two independent editors before voicing.
description: In West Bengal, 76.5% of women aged 15 to 49 had a bank account they themselves use in NFHS-5 (2019-21) and 95.3% in NFHS-6 (2023-24): up 18.8 points against India's 10.4 (78.6% to 89.0%). West Bengal moved from the lower half of 34 ranked states and UTs to the top three, with Ladakh (95.5%) and Karnataka (94.7%).
Women aged 15 to 49 with a bank account they use. Survey estimates. Blank: Manipur (no NFHS-6 fact sheet yet) and Lakshadweep (small sample). The table shows how much, not why.
